full_conjecture_status: Not solved; no infeasible core or actual all-deficient oriented graph found.

main_unconditional_result.statement: Every finite nonempty oriented graph with at most five distinct inclusion-maximal incoming-neighborhood sets has at least one corresponding maximal equivalence class all of whose vertices have SNP. Total order is unrestricted.
main_unconditional_result.proof: Select deficient representatives if every maximal class has one. Every target's pattern of core predecessors is contained in a core incoming set. A certified nonnegative core vector gives columnwise exact-second predecessor mass at least first predecessor mass, contradicting positive gap at every selected representative.
main_unconditional_result.mathematical_review: Root and two separate agents independently reconstructed the pattern transfer, source exclusion, tournament cut argument and whole-class representative argument, PASS.
main_unconditional_result.dependency_scope: No minimal-counterexample packet, protection closure, arc minimality, true-twin normal form or random-graph hypothesis is used.

computer_assisted_component.generator: search_small_core_certificates.py; exact existing Z3 used for forty witnesses only
computer_assisted_component.verification: All three exact integer implementations PASS; none relies on LP solver correctness or floating-point tolerances to validate the witnesses.

other_accepted_results.result: A tournament representative core of any size supplies the certificate analytically via Fisher losing density. Universal feasibility of the pattern system for all cores is equivalent to full SNC: strict dual multiplicities produce a labelled finite counterexample after adding full-pattern representatives.
other_accepted_results.review: Root and two independent reviews PASS. No assertion of universal feasibility is made.

other_accepted_results.result: Pattern certificates lift from maximal-incoming representative induced cores. An iterated core of at most five vertices, or a tournament of any size, gives an original SNP vertex in that core. It suffices to study terminal cores with pairwise distinct incomparable incoming sets.
other_accepted_results.review: Root proof and independent framework reconstruction PASS.
other_accepted_results.scope: This is a certificate-system reduction, not an assertion that an actual counterexample's smaller induced core is itself an unweighted counterexample. One successful representative chain does not imply an entire original class is SNP.

other_accepted_results.result: Any original-snapshot row map rho with incoming(v) subset incoming(rho(v)) gives an oriented graph with new gap(v)>=old gap(rho(v)). In a GLOBALLY minimum-order counterexample every vertex receives an entire maximal incoming class whose gaps all equal one; at least three such classes form a complete-arc directed cycle.
other_accepted_results.review: Root and two independent reconstructions PASS. Arbitrary full-domain maps and changed-head intermediates are included.
other_accepted_results.checks: 11122 subset maps, 13656 full-domain maps, 6023 maps with a head inside the modified set; all exact checks PASS.
other_accepted_results.scope: Gap one is not residual one. The covering theorem needs globally smallest counterexample order, not merely induced-deletion or arc-subset minimality.

other_accepted_results.result: Choose a counterexample lexicographically by minimum order, minimum total arcs, maximum total gap, and maximum squared outgoing-class sizes. Incoming containment then orders outdegrees; protection strictly decreases missing degree. Equal incoming sets have equal outgoing sets and form independent true-twin modules.
other_accepted_results.review: Root and separate-agent algebra and cloning reviews PASS.
other_accepted_results.scope: A conditional representative normal form; not a property asserted for every earlier arc-minimal graph or an altered closure graph.

other_accepted_results.result: At strong Good equality, closure creates no reachability from original nongood-second remaining partners into unpaid far partners. Any far partners not reachable from these original seeds contain an ORIGINAL directed cycle. At residual two all partners are original nongood-second; at residual three there is at most one far partner and an original seed-to-far arc.
other_accepted_results.review: General path/cycle proof and corrected low-residual arguments independently reconstructed, PASS.
other_accepted_results.finite_scope: 61011 graph checks support the invariants but did not cover all difficult positive-gap mixed branches. They are not the proof of the low-residual corollaries.
other_accepted_results.remaining: The all-second and strictly Good-surplus negative-gap cases are not eliminated.

additional_negative_gap_global_constrain.statement: In the original strong arc-set-minimal class, a weak-closure feed with one original missing partner has that partner in its original exact second set. If original P(f) is empty, every unprotected Far head and f itself lie in the original external second boundary of its first set, giving d_plus>=g+t+2 and n>=g+3t+5.
additional_negative_gap_global_constrain.review: Author proof and root independent reconstruction PASS.
additional_negative_gap_global_constrain.scope: This excludes the earlier ten-point local model through its failure of the GLOBAL boundary inequality, but leaves unbounded parameter ranges and does not improve the universal residual bound.

adversarial_correction.rejected_statement: The external second boundary of P is always contained in the incoming neighborhood of the target, so an exceptional missing Far head cannot lie in the remainder.
adversarial_correction.finding: False as a geometric statement. Root identified the unsupported containment, confirmed by the independent framework reviewer. Six-vertex control [34,4,24,16,1,2] has an exceptional missing Far head in the external second layer and remainder.
adversarial_correction.repair: Residual-two exclusion uses the empty remainder directly. Residual-three permits a unique exceptional Far partner; if two Far partners existed they would consume two elements of a one-element remainder. All saved accepted claims use the repaired proof.
adversarial_correction.scope: The control has Seymour vertices and is not a conjecture counterexample. No prior accepted result depended on the rejected claim.

primary_literature_comparison.note: Brantner--Brockman--Kay--Snively already establish gap-one predecessors and a gap-one directed cycle in their minimal-criminal framework. These facts alone are not claimed as new; the current coupled-cover argument specifies entire maximal incoming classes. Their extremal ordering differs, so scope is stated explicitly.
Fisher's tournament losing-density existence supplies the analytic tournament-core certificate. The general pattern inequalities and finite core tables are separately proved and verified.
Comparison with vertex-minimal counterexample and blow-up reductions; no assertion that the current maximum-incoming-class criterion follows automatically from their minimum-degree result.
The July 2026 preprint studies a matching strengthening in specified graph classes; it is not a reported general solution. A full novelty or coverage audit of the current results remains outstanding.
